material.description: Live reproduction: keydown Shift, then window blur, recorded the pack dispatch log with only the shift down event (dispatch 1792859828185-6599-dc1cafad6b690914).
material.subject: Does a window blur reach the pack with the modifiers released?
material.witness_evidence: Live page, dispatch_action spy: keydown Shift then blur sent one key event (shift down, shift true) and no key up (dispatch 1792859828185-6599-dc1cafad6b690914). After the play.js fix the same run sent key up with shift false (dispatch 1792859865102-6619-466d4037f6a6d6b8).
